run_pysc2_agent: run the pysc2_agent CLI to launch an RL agent in the StarCraft II learning environment
run_pysc2_play: run the pysc2_play CLI to play StarCraft II matches with configurable agents
run_pysc2_replay_info: run the pysc2_replay_info CLI to extract metadata from StarCraft II replay files
build_pysc2_package: build the PySC2 Python package using setuptools with custom _build output directory
install_pysc2_dependencies: install PySC2 and its dependencies including s2clientprotocol, dm_env, and pygame
